notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/swirl-uk__bigym2 --backend fake (exit 0; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, model_id deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run_id wB2-060) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached or run, and a simulated family driver has no hardware backend. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names family mujoco and helper MujocoDriver, but its AST-confirmed entry symbol is bigym.loco.gym_adapter:GymnasiumEnv, a gymnasium.Env whose interface is reset/step/action_space/observation_space; a MujocoDriver would bind the raw model state (qpos/qvel/ctrl), not this class, so the package is a GymnasiumDriver with native = bigym.loco.gym_adapter:GymnasiumEnv. The package serves one environment of the card, drawer_top_open (DrawerTopOpenG1, bigym/loco/tasks.py:158); NOT COVERED: the other drawer/cupboard entry classes DrawerTopCloseG1, DrawersAllOpenG1 and DrawersAllCloseG1, and the rest of the TASKS registry. The card's mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but the upstream package is not installed where the gate runs and package code never imports the clone, so the fake backend is this package's pure Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py), not the upstream MuJoCo environment; the sim backend was not run and the fake was never compared with upstream. NOT COVERED: rigid-body dynamics, contacts, the G1 robot and hand actuation, the MuJoCo scene, the task success/reward/termination conditions, the numpy random stream and the registered 13500-inner-step budget (1350 outer steps at the default 10 inner steps per outer step); fidelity is F0, timestep 20 ms from the default 50 Hz outer control rate (bigym/loco/config.py:140-141), determinism seeded with Python's random.Random while upstream draws its episode seed from numpy. ARRAY SIZES: the fake observation is a 1-camera 3-channel 4x4 rgb placeholder plus a 12-value state; the real default rgb observation is 3 cameras x 3 channels x 84x84 uint8 (bigym/loco/config.py:33,154-156,164; bigym/loco/env.py:1048-1056) and the real state length is the sum over the configured state keys (bigym/loco/env.py:1011-1039). The fake action vector is 24 placeholder values; the real action length is computed from the outer base slots, the selected limb actuators and the gripper count (bigym/loco/env.py:921-923,1004-1009). No rendering, no snapshot/restore and no hardware path are offered. WARNINGS (expected, PLAYBOOK.md section 8): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only arms the seed of the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs (seed in cap.world.reset.v1, seed in cap.world.seed.v1, ticks and action.values[*]); no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. Only the catalogue classes cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. The package has no site-limits.example.json because it declares no operator-required bound. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
